Description: GIS Map runtime error "Map container is already initialized" during tab switching
Root Cause: Leaflet L.map() attached to DOM without unmounting prior map instance during React re-renders
Fix: Added cleanup return function inside useEffect hook calling mapInstance.remove() and resetting DOM ref

Description: Newly submitted citizen grievances failed to display as pins on interactive Leaflet GIS map
Root Cause: GIS map was rendering only static projects array and had not subscribed to live tickets state
Fix: Integrated useCivicStore tickets listener creating dynamic Leaflet circle markers with hazard colors

Description: Grievance form accepted invalid phone numbers (e.g. "123" or alphabet characters) without error
Root Cause: Mobile input field only verified non-empty string and did not enforce Indian 10-digit regex
Fix: Added client-side regex check /^[6-9]\d{9}$/ in ComplaintFormModal and validated payload schema in Express

Description: Landmark selection defaulted to generic ward centroid coordinates rather than exact road location
Root Cause: Absence of localized landmark coordinate snapping; form relied on fallback ward centroid
Fix: Implemented LANDMARK_COORDINATES lookup table with fuzzy matching plus interactive mini-map pinpoint picker

Description: Unauthorized users were able to mark contractor road works as "Resolved" without verification
Root Cause: Missing role authorization and reporter-identity verification guards on ticket resolution actions
Fix: Implemented reporter-only verification logic requiring matching citizen ID / admin passkey before state transition

Description: Uploading 5+ MB mobile camera photos caused server memory spikes and excessive database JSON payload size
Root Cause: Raw JPEG files were directly encoded to uncompressed Base64 strings (7+ MB per ticket)
Fix: Implemented client-side HTML5 Canvas 2D image downscaling and WebP compression pipeline (<250KB payload)

Description: Duplicate real-time ticket alerts and memory leak after repeated tab switching
Root Cause: Socket.io event listeners were re-registered on every component render without teardown
Fix: Wrapped socket subscriptions in useEffect with dependency array and added socket.off() teardown handlers

Description: Defect Liability Period (DLP) warranty countdown displayed "NaN Months Remaining" on certain browsers
Root Cause: Date parsing used browser-dependent Date.parse() which fails on non-standard date formats
Fix: Standardized all date storage to ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD) and created a robust date-difference utility helper

Description: Marathi localization showed raw English keys for newly added hazard categories (e.g. DRAINAGE_OVERFLOW)
Root Cause: Dictionary divergence between en and mr translation objects in translations.ts
Fix: Synchronized all localization keys across English and Marathi dictionaries to achieve 100% bilingual parity

Description: Mobile Citizen Feed navigation bar overlapped the bottom-most complaint cards on small screens
Root Cause: Global layout container lacked viewport bottom safe-area offset padding when fixed navigation was active
Fix: Added dynamic viewport padding pb-24 to main content wrappers in BottomMobileNav.tsx and App.tsx

Description: KPI banner showed hardcoded counts that did not update when new tickets were filed
Root Cause: Dashboard component used static mock data rather than deriving counts dynamically from live tickets state
Fix: Refactored KpiBanner.tsx to compute active grievances and SLAs dynamically from live database state

Description: AI Chatbot suggestion chips did not autofill the complaint modal when clicked
Root Cause: Chatbot modal was not communicating state to ComplaintFormModal due to missing parent callback handler
Fix: Passed shared callback onSelectHazard(category title) from parent App.tsx to enable 1-click complaint pre-filling

Description: Dark mode text contrast was illegible when printing reports or viewing on low-contrast projectors
Root Cause: CSS variables for background and text lacked high-contrast fallback tokens for print stylesheets
Fix: Added explicit @media print CSS overrides and high-contrast color classes for municipal report exports

Description: GPS coordinate geofence allowed coordinates outside Nashik Municipal Corporation boundaries
Root Cause: Absence of geographic bounding box verification allowed test coordinates from Mumbai into Nashik wards
Fix: Implemented bounding box filter (lat: 19.85 - 20.15 lng: 73.65 - 73.95) rejecting coordinates outside NMC limits
